Key_Event: Pre-crisis peak profitability; subprime exposure emerging.
Global Financial Crisis; raises CHF 10B from Qatar & Saudi investors to avoid Swiss state bailout; creates illusion of invulnerability.
Strong trading rebound; maintains large Wall Street investment bank footprint.
Basel III regulations introduced; beginning of increased capital requirements.
Urs Rohner elected Chairman; Eurozone debt crisis pressures earnings.
Major cost-cutting program launched; accelerated Basel III implementation.
Deleveraging balance sheet; legal pressures in US intensify.
Pleads guilty to US felony charges for aiding tax evasion; pays $2.6B fine; Rohner and Dougan retain positions despite public outcry.
Tidjane Thiam takes over as CEO; initiates radical pivot away from investment banking to wealth management; massive goodwill impairment.
$5.28B settlement with US Department of Justice regarding legacy residential mortgage-backed securities (RMBS).
US Tax Cuts and Jobs Act triggers CHF 2.3B deferred tax asset write-down; operating performance begins improving.
Completion of Thiam's 3-year restructuring; first full-year profit since 2014.
Highest profit in a decade (CHF 3.4B); overshadowed by corporate espionage scandal (spying on Iqbal Khan); Thiam forced out in Feb 2020.
Thomas Gottstein appointed CEO; COVID-19 pandemic provisions; unhedged Archegos swap positions quietly accumulate.
Dual disaster: Greensill Capital collapses ($10B fund freeze) & Archegos defaults ($5.5B prime brokerage loss); Horta-Osório becomes Chairman.
Horta-Osório ousted for COVID breaches; Gottstein replaced by Körner; social media panic sparks Q4 bank run (CHF 110.5B net outflows); CHF 4B capital raise.
Terminal run: March 14 material weaknesses admitted; March 15 Saudi 'absolutely not' remark; March 19 emergency Sunday takeover by UBS for CHF 3.0B; CHF 15.6B AT1 wipeout.
